_how_to: One row per vendor statement meeting the commitment definition. Copy each quote exactly from its source document. language = exploratory | conditional | firm. commitment_ids refer to C01-C07. A single statement may map to multiple commitments. Customer context belongs in commitments.json. Complete: 14 statements across HB-01 to HB-06. HB-05 (internal evidence), HB-07 (references only) and HB-08 (customer-authored) contain no Elva statements.

statements.speaker: Priya Raman (Elva)
statements.quote: We're exploring whether Elva's pre-built connector to a blockchain analytics provider can return real-time screening results for Polygon wallets in time for your launch.

statements.speaker: Priya Raman (Elva)
statements.quote: We're targeting a 1 December go-live, provided Harbour Bank's sandbox and testnet access is available by 15 November.

statements.speaker: Maya Chen (Elva)
statements.quote: If Product grants named approval, Elva's pre-built integration to the selected blockchain analytics provider could return real-time screening results for Polygon wallets as a limited beta; planned general availability in Singapore is 31 March 2027.

statements.speaker: Elva (RFP response)
statements.quote: Through its pre-built connector to a blockchain analytics provider, Elva will return real-time wallet-screening results for Ethereum and Polygon before every NUSD payout is released.

statements.speaker: Elva (proposal)
statements.quote: Every NUSD payout on Polygon will be screened in real time through Elva's analytics integration before release, from the 1 December launch.

statements.speaker: Elva (proposal)
statements.quote: NUSD payouts on Ethereum will be screened in real time through Elva's analytics integration before release.

statements.speaker: Elva (proposal)
statements.quote: The payout ledger connector will handle up to 12,000 payouts per day at launch.

statements.speaker: Elva (proposal)
statements.quote: The payout ledger connector will handle up to 40,000 payouts per day by the end of the first year.

statements.speaker: Elva (proposal)
statements.quote: For payouts to exchange-hosted wallets, VASP counterparty data exchange will be generally available in Singapore by 31 March 2027.

statements.speaker: Elva (draft SOW)
statements.quote: The payout ledger connector will handle up to 12,000 payouts per day at launch.

statements.speaker: Elva (draft SOW)
statements.quote: Provider will provide NUSD wallet screening for HarbourPay Global payouts on Ethereum and Polygon through Elva's pre-built connector to Customer's configured blockchain analytics service, in accordance with the Wallet Screening Specification in Annex A.

statements.speaker: Elva (draft SOW)
statements.quote: A.1 Ethereum: each recipient wallet is screened through the analytics integration in real time before the payout is released.

statements.speaker: Elva (draft SOW)
statements.quote: A.2 Polygon: recipient wallets are screened through the analytics integration in batches at hourly intervals.

statements.speaker: Elva (draft SOW)
statements.quote: A Polygon payout is released after the next completed screening batch returns a clear result.
